about: The phone layout: the HUD pieces do not overlap; run with --device phone (and --quality low).

steps.expect: (() => { const ids = ['#lk-obj', '#lk-map', '#lk-eff', '#lk-stick', '#lk-me .ph']; const r = ids.map((s) => document.querySelector(s)?.getBoundingClientRect()).filter((b) => b && b.width); for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < r.length; j++) { const a = r[i], b = r[j]; if (a.left < b.right && b.left < a.right && a.top < b.bottom && b.top < a.bottom) return false; } return true; })()
steps.name: objective, minimap, Efforts, stick and badge do not overlap
